name: Chromatic Aberration
desc: RGB channels split apart toward the frame edge with drifting chroma scanlines — a lens-fringe / CRT glitch pass that pumps on the bass.

offset.doc: channel separation amount (fraction of min dim)

edge.doc: how far the fringe reaches in from the edge (1 = full frame)

style.doc: aesthetic: clean split / analog VHS / block datamosh / spectral prism / clinical negative
